title: Build AI Agents & Automations Without Code
subtitle: Automate repetitive work and build AI assistants, chatbots and agents with Zapier, Make and n8n – no coding needed.
description:
This course is for operations people, founders, freelancers, marketers and consultants who spend too many hours copying data between apps, answering the same questions and chasing follow-ups. You will learn to build AI-powered automations and simple AI agents using no-code tools like Zapier, Make and n8n, without writing code.

You start by learning the difference between a plain automation, an AI-powered workflow and a true AI agent, and how to map a process and estimate the time it will save. Then you master the building blocks: triggers, actions, data mapping, filters, routers, error handling and AI steps that summarise, classify, extract and draft. You will also learn to handle API keys safely and keep AI costs and rate limits under control.

Across the course you build four practical projects: a lead-qualification flow with CRM and WhatsApp or email follow-up, an AI inbox triage assistant, a customer FAQ bot grounded in your own documents, and a weekly report agent that waits for human approval before sending anything.

The final module covers what turns a demo into dependable client work: testing, monitoring and failure handling, plus how to find, scope, price and maintain automation projects for Indian small and medium businesses. Every lesson is text-based, practical and ends with a hands-on exercise.
audience: Operations and admin professionals buried in repetitive copy-paste work
Founders and small business owners who want leads and enquiries handled faster
Freelancers and consultants who want to offer automation services
Marketers who want lead follow-up and reporting to run on their own
Non-coders curious about building real AI agents and chatbots
outcomes: Explain the difference between an automation, an AI workflow and an AI agent
Map a business process and estimate the hours automation will save
Build workflows in Zapier, Make or n8n with triggers, filters, routers and error handling
Add AI steps that classify, extract, summarise and draft with reliable structured output
Build a lead-qualification flow with Google Sheets or CRM and WhatsApp or email follow-up
Create a customer FAQ bot that answers only from your own documents
Build tool-using agents with human approval before anything important is sent
Handle API keys, costs, rate limits, testing and monitoring like a professional
prerequisites: Comfortable using Gmail, Google Sheets and a chat assistant like ChatGPT or Claude
A laptop and free or trial accounts on at least one automation tool
tools: CRMs such as Zoho, HubSpot or Pipedrive
projects: A lead-qualification automation that scores enquiries with AI, logs them to a sheet or CRM and follows up on WhatsApp or email.
An AI inbox triage assistant that labels, prioritises and summarises email and saves draft replies for review.
A document-grounded FAQ bot that answers customer questions from your own policies and hands off to a human when unsure.
A weekly report agent that gathers data with tools, drafts a report and sends it only after human approval.

seo.title: No-Code AI Agents & Automation Course
seo.description: Learn to build AI agents, chatbots and automations with Zapier, Make and n8n – no coding. 4 real projects for Indian businesses and freelancers.

faqs.q: Do I need to know coding to take this course?
faqs.a: No. Every project is built with no-code tools by connecting steps and mapping fields. A few lessons show optional settings like JSON output, but we explain them in plain English and you never have to write a program.

faqs.q: Which tool should I use – Zapier, Make or n8n?
faqs.a: The course is tool-neutral and explains each step so you can follow along in any of the three. Lesson 3 compares them so you can choose; many learners start with one and add n8n later for heavier AI agent work.

faqs.q: Will I have to pay for tools or AI usage?
faqs.a: You can learn using free plans and trials, though limits change over time. AI provider APIs are usually pay-as-you-go, and for the course projects usage is typically small; we show you how to set spending limits so there are no surprises.

faqs.q: Can I use this to earn money as a freelancer?
faqs.a: The final module covers finding, scoping, pricing and maintaining automation projects for Indian small businesses. We teach the method honestly, but we cannot promise any particular income – that depends on your niche, effort and results.
Yes. A certificate of completion is issued when you mark every lesson in the course as complete.
You can get a full refund within 7 days of purchase, as long as you have completed less than 30% of the course.
